The study focuses on the prevalence and characteristics of infections among men who have sex with men in Belgium, as published in Acta Clinica Belgica in 2020, volume 75, issue 2, pages 91–95. 2. The World Health Organization (WHO) released comprehensive guidelines in 2016 for the treatment of Chlamydia trachomatis infections, providing evidence-based recommendations for clinical management. 3. Similarly, the WHO also published detailed guidelines in 2016 for the treatment of Neisseria gonorrhoeae infections, addressing antimicrobial resistance and optimal therapeutic approaches.
